tone: Direct and brief; warm and upbeat with teammates; helpful, owns next steps; light humor
greeting: Hi everyone (only when opening a thread or DM; replies start with the answer)
phrasesToAvoid: I hope this finds you well
styleGuide: Median message is 11.5 words (p75 23.3); 91% are one line. Leads with the answer or the ask; context after, if any. Often joins clauses with semicolons. Uses contractions throughout. Casual abbreviations: eod, ooo.
slackGuide: Mentions the person first in group threads (14% of messages start with a mention). Bullets for lists of links/options (9%), numbered lists for multi-part questions or recommendations (0%). Emoji level 1/3 (e.g. :running: :slightly_smiling_face:); none in serious or customer messages. No sign-off on Slack. Signature moves: I'll … (commitment).
emailGuide: Rarely emails, so infer from Slack: keep his directness, add "Hi <first name>," and a one-line opener, use complete sentences, no abbreviations or emoji, close with one forward-looking line and "Thanks," + first name.
customerGuide: Account and customer channels: median 27 words; more complete sentences, answers technical questions in structured detail, routes commercial questions to the AE.
